title: Give your Mac or PC the top Office apps while this 2024 license is $99.97 for Black Friday
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Pay just $99.97 once (reg. $149.99) for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote on one Mac or PC for Black Friday.

The family budget has its own spreadsheet, the history paper is due Friday, and someone still needs to make slides for the group project. Microsoft Office 2024 Home for Mac or PC is $99.97 for Black Friday (reg. $149.99), and one payment gets you Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote for life. There are also no monthly or annual fees.

Let the updated apps you already know and love help with the everyday hustle. Word gives you the formatting controls to turn a rough draft into a paper that’s ready to hand in. In Excel, you can use the FILTER function to pull out just the grocery expenses from a household budget. That filtered list updates as you add new entries, so you can see what you’ve spent without sorting through every row.

PowerPoint lets you record narration for a presentation, which comes in handy when the assignment calls for a video. And OneNote gives you a place to keep class notes or plans for the next family trip.

The desktop apps also work offline, so a spotty Wi-Fi connection doesn’t have to put your paper or presentation on hold. The one-use code is tied to your Microsoft account, and the license covers one Mac or PC. However, Outlook isn’t included.

Get Microsoft Office 2024 Home for Mac or PC for $99.97 (reg. $149.99) this Black Friday. Pay once and skip the subscription for good.
